sql: SELECT PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.5) AS d,PERCENTILE(v,0.5) AS b,MEDIAN(DISTINCT v) AS m,MEDIAN(v) AS mb FROM VALUES (1D),(1D),(1D),(9D),(20D) AS t(v)
SELECT PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(0.25D,0.5D),f) AS d,PERCENTILE(v,ARRAY(0.25D,0.5D),f) AS b FROM VALUES (1D,1L),(1D,1L),(1D,1L),(1D,2L),(9D,4L),(20D,1L) AS t(v,f)

SELECT PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.25D) AS scalar,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(1D,0.25D,0.5D,0D,0.75D,0.5D)) AS a,PERCENTILE(v,ARRAY(1D,0.25D,0.5D,0D,0.75D,0.5D)) AS b,MEDIAN(DISTINCT v) AS m,MEDIAN(v) AS mb FROM samples
SELECT PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.25D,f) AS scalar,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(1D,0.25D,0.5D,0D,0.75D,0.5D),f) AS a,PERCENTILE(v,ARRAY(1D,0.25D,0.5D,0D,0.75D,0.5D),f) AS b FROM samples

SELECT g,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.25D) AS scalar,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(1D,0.25D,0.5D,0D,0.75D,0.5D)) AS a,PERCENTILE(v,ARRAY(1D,0.25D,0.5D,0D,0.75D,0.5D)) AS b,MEDIAN(DISTINCT v) AS m,COUNT(*) AS n,SUM(v) AS s,AVG(v) AS mean,COUNT(DISTINCT w) AS w FROM samples GROUP BY g ORDER BY g NULLS FIRST

SELECT g,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.25D,f) AS scalar,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(1D,0.25D,0.5D,0D,0.75D,0.5D),f) AS a,PERCENTILE(v,ARRAY(1D,0.25D,0.5D,0D,0.75D,0.5D),f) AS b FROM samples GROUP BY g ORDER BY g NULLS FIRST

SELECT g,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(1D,0.25D,0.5D,0D,0.75D,0.5D)) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS a,MEDIAN(DISTINCT v) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS m,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.5) FILTER(WHERE NOT keep) AS f,PERCENTILE(v,0.5) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS b FROM samples GROUP BY g ORDER BY g NULLS FIRST

SELECT g,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.25D,f) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS scalar,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(1D,0.25D,0.5D,0D,0.75D,0.5D),f) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS a,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.5,f) FILTER(WHERE NOT keep) AS f,PERCENTILE(v,0.5,f) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS b FROM samples GROUP BY g ORDER BY g NULLS FIRST
SELECT g,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.25D,f) AS v,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.25D,f+1) AS f,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT w,0.25D,f) AS w FROM samples GROUP BY g ORDER BY g NULLS FIRST
SELECT g%2 AS k,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v*2+1,ARRAY(1D,0.25D,0.5D,0D,0.75D,0.5D),f+1) AS a,PERCENTILE(v*2+1,0.5,f+1) AS b FROM samples GROUP BY g%2 ORDER BY k NULLS FIRST
SELECT PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.5) AS scalar,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(1D,0.25D,0.5D,0D,0.75D,0.5D),f) AS a,MEDIAN(DISTINCT v) AS m,COUNT(*) AS n FROM samples WHERE false
SELECT PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.5,f) AS scalar,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(1D,0.25D,0.5D,0D,0.75D,0.5D)) AS a,MEDIAN(DISTINCT v) AS m FROM samples WHERE v IS NULL
SELECT PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.5,f) AS scalar,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(1D,0.25D,0.5D,0D,0.75D,0.5D),f) AS a FROM samples WHERE f=0 OR f IS NULL

SELECT PERCENTILE(DISTINCT 7D,0.5) AS a,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT 7D,ARRAY(0D,0.5D),f) AS f,MEDIAN(DISTINCT 7D) AS m FROM samples

SELECT PERCENTILE(DISTINCT 7D,0.5) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS a,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT 7D,ARRAY(0D,0.5D),f) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS f,MEDIAN(DISTINCT 7D) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS m,APPROX_PERCENTILE(DISTINCT 7D,0.5) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS ap FROM samples
SELECT PERCENTILE(DISTINCT 3D+4D,0.5) AS a,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT 3D+4D,ARRAY(0D,0.5D),f) AS f,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.5,CAST(1 AS BIGINT)) AS v,APPROX_PERCENTILE(DISTINCT 3D+4D,0.5) AS ap FROM samples
SELECT g,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.5,f) AS d FROM samples GROUP BY g HAVING PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.5,f)>4 ORDER BY g NULLS FIRST

SELECT PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.25D,f) AS d,APPROX_PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.5) AS a,FIRST(v,true) AS f,LAST(v,true) AS l,COLLECT_LIST(v) AS values FROM (SELECT v,f FROM samples WHERE g=0 ORDER BY id DESC)

SELECT g,keep,GROUPING_ID() AS gid,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(0D,0.5D)) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS e,MEDIAN(DISTINCT v) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS m,APPROX_PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.5) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS a,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(0.25D,0.5D),f) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS f,PERCENTILE(v,0.5,f) AS b,COUNT(*) AS n FROM samples GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((g),(keep)) ORDER BY gid,g,keep NULLS FIRST

SELECT g,GROUPING_ID() AS gid,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(0D,0.5D)) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS e,MEDIAN(DISTINCT v) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS m,APPROX_PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.5) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS a,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(0.25D,0.5D),f) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS f,PERCENTILE(v,0.5,f) AS b,COUNT(*) AS n FROM samples GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((g),(),(g),()) ORDER BY gid,g NULLS FIRST

SELECT g,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.5) AS e,MEDIAN(DISTINCT v) AS m,APPROX_PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.5) AS a,PERCENTILE_APPROX(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(0D,0.5D,1D),100) AS aa,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.25D,f) AS f FROM samples GROUP BY g ORDER BY g NULLS FIRST
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY v) AS c,PERCENTILE_DISC(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY v DESC) AS d FROM samples

SELECT g,GROUPING_ID() AS gid,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(0D,0.5D)) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS e,MEDIAN(DISTINCT v) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS m,APPROX_PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.5) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS a,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(0.25D,0.5D),f) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS f,PERCENTILE(v,0.5,f) AS b,COUNT(*) AS n FROM samples GROUP BY ROLLUP(g) ORDER BY gid,g NULLS FIRST

SELECT g,keep,GROUPING_ID() AS gid,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(0D,0.5D)) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS e,MEDIAN(DISTINCT v) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS m,APPROX_PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.5) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS a,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(0.25D,0.5D),f) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS f,PERCENTILE(v,0.5,f) AS b,COUNT(*) AS n FROM samples GROUP BY CUBE(g,keep) ORDER BY gid,g,keep NULLS FIRST

SELECT g,keep,GROUPING_ID() AS gid,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(0D,0.5D)) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS e,MEDIAN(DISTINCT v) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS m,APPROX_PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.5) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS a,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(0.25D,0.5D),f) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS f,PERCENTILE(v,0.5,f) AS b,COUNT(*) AS n FROM samples GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((g),(keep)) ORDER BY gid,g,keep NULLS FIRST

SELECT g,GROUPING_ID() AS gid,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(0D,0.5D)) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS e,MEDIAN(DISTINCT v) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS m,APPROX_PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,0.5) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS a,PERCENTILE(DISTINCT v,ARRAY(0.25D,0.5D),f) FILTER(WHERE keep) AS f,PERCENTILE(v,0.5,f) AS b,COUNT(*) AS n FROM samples GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((g),(),(g),()) ORDER BY gid,g NULLS FIRST
